decisions.decision: Qwen3.5 2B Q4_K_M under llama.cpp is a portability and Aura E2E spike only.
decisions.rationale: Its family-bootstrap confidence interval crossed zero and it is not Aura's real configured model. Any Aura E2E override must be written through the database only, scoped temporarily, and restored with proof.

decisions.decision: PostgreSQL is authoritative and Neo4j plus the existing agent-memory infrastructure are replayable private projections.
decisions.rationale: This preserves immutable owner-scoped evidence, identity deletion, auditability, and rebuild safety without routing adaptive payloads through LLM-facing memory tools.

decisions.decision: Adaptive coverage includes every supported decision domain, not reasoning alone.
decisions.rationale: The next contract must cover reasoning, tool, skill, knowledge, memory, model/provider, context, document, multimodal, and retry/recovery decisions.

decisions.decision: Delete the complete legacy reasoning and tool learning stack and its stored data.
decisions.rationale: The operator explicitly authorized deletion; the stack bypassed the unified policy gate and violated off and rollback baseline semantics.

decisions.decision: Do not ship a test-only policy mutation service.
decisions.rationale: CLAUDE.md forbids dark code; a mutation API must land with a real authorized production caller and same-slice audit proof.

decisions.decision: The current release stays observation-only and serves static Aura behavior.
decisions.rationale: Typed assignments, cohorts, challengers, projector lifecycle, canary serving, and real-model evidence are not implemented.
